Few-shot.rationale: The customer review summary shows a score of '4.8 out of 5', yet all five star icons are rendered completely empty (unfilled), directly conflicting with the numeric rating.
Few-shot.improvement_suggestion: Fill the star icons proportionally to visually represent the 4.8 out of 5 average rating.

Few-shot.rationale: The color options under 'Select Color' display colored circles without any corresponding color name or text label indicating which color variant is currently active.
Few-shot.improvement_suggestion: Display the name of the selected color next to or above the swatches (e.g., 'Select Color: Off-White').

Few-shot.rationale: The secondary thumbnail image displays an entirely different product style (a black athletic trainer/runner with an amber heel) compared to the primary canvas low-top sneaker shown in the main view and lifestyle photo, creating confusion about the actual item being purchased.
Few-shot.improvement_suggestion: Ensure all product gallery images represent views and details of the same footwear model.
